$comment: Naming and scoping policy for `pnpm gen:api`. This file holds NO schema: every route, method, parameter and response type comes from docs/api/openapi.json, which `pnpm contract:export` writes from the FastAPI routers and Pydantic models. What lives here is the part a machine cannot derive — the names humans chose, and the deliberate exclusions. Edit this file; never edit a generated file.

serverOnly.$comment: Operations the app shell must never call, keyed `<method> <path>`. They stay in the contract and out of the generated registry and query keys. The frontend contract test keeps its own copy of this set as a belt-and-braces check, so a set that is too LARGE here fails `pnpm test:web` loudly rather than silently dropping an endpoint.

operations.get /metrics: Prometheus metrics are scraped server-side, not fetched by the browser.

operations.$comment: Per-operation naming. `route` is the key in the generated route registry. `query` is present only for operations the UI caches under a TanStack Query key: `name` is the factory member and `segments` are the key parts appended to the root, which is how a deliberate cache hierarchy (invalidating the parent also invalidates the child) is expressed. An operation missing from this map still generates: `route` falls back to a camel-cased path plus a verb suffix, and no query key is emitted. So adding an endpoint needs no edit here unless you want a hand-picked name.

escapeHatch.$comment: The generator owns the mechanical slice only. Everything named here is hand-written on purpose because it encodes per-app judgement the contract does not describe, and `pnpm gen:api` never writes to these paths. If you need behaviour the generator cannot express, it belongs in one of these files — not in a generated one.

handWritten.apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts: error policy, API base resolution, the legacy-route fallback, CORS diagnostics and the XHR upload transport
handWritten.apps/web/src/lib/queries.ts: every caching, polling, invalidation and query-vs-mutation decision
handWritten.packages/shared/src/types.ts: the public barrel: re-exports the generated types and adds frontend-only types the API knows nothing about
